verdict.rationale: The Cloud API docs cover pairing multiple Solo readers to a SumUp account and naming them, with Virtual Solo available to test the pairing flow. An agent could reach SumUp APIs through the managed MCP server or the Agent Toolkit. However, nothing in the evidence shows a location or site entity that can be created via API, so the story cannot be done end-to-end. Missing for 10: location creation API, explicit API-driven reader registration endpoint docs, confirmation that the MCP/toolkit exposes reader pairing, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven provisioning.
